entries.2a5ce246421136fb: A reporting segment that sells amusement equipment such as arcade game machines, as well as used equipment, sticker printing paper, parts and prizes. entries.47c02a12ce890dcb: A reporting segment that operates amusement arcades centered on the game center “Apina,” as well as batting centers, bowling alleys and others. The business is centered on Nagano Prefecture and has expanded across Japan, and the number of stores as of March 31, 2026 was 73. It mainly consists of prize games, video games and medal games, and also conducts “managed placement,” in which machines are leased in spaces at shopping centers and hot spring facilities and management is entrusted to the facility owners. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥18,968 million.
